title: Happy Hauntings at Dutch Wonderland
description:
Happy Hauntings at Dutch Wonderland brings Halloween magic to life—without the scares. Bring the whole family for kid-friendly, lively entertainment packed with silly, not-spooky fun around every corner. Happy Hauntings is a delightful- not frightful – way to celebrate Halloween together.

Buy a 2027 Gold or Platinum Pass now and get this year’s Happy Hauntings FREE! Save up to $60 and enjoy more than a year of unlimited admission and royal perks.

Looking to stay at our Dutch Wonderland Inn and play all day? Check out our special Happy Hauntings Packages

title: Lancaster City Scavenger Hunt
description:
Imagine turning the streets of Lancaster into a real-life adventure—solving puzzles, uncovering secrets, and winning prizes along the way!
Now’s your chance! Introducing Lancaster’s Ultimate Scavenger Challenge, created by Unique Lancaster Experiences—where discovery, excitement, and local charm come together.

???? Your Adventure Awaits:
???? Follow inventive clues through Lancaster’s picturesque and historic downtown
???? Earn fun rewards as you complete challenges
???? Discover tucked-away gardens, arcades, historic markets, and more
???? Access special discounts at participating local businesses
⏱ Choose your pace—go head-to-head with friends or enjoy a leisurely journey

???? What Makes It Unforgettable?
????‍????‍????‍???? Great for everyone—couples, families, birthday celebrations, team events, or spontaneous outings
???? Hands-On & Entertaining—history comes to life through interactive games, not lectures
???? Creative Challenges—snap silly photos, solve riddles, and compete for glory
???? On-Call Help—first-time visitor? A friendly local guide is available if you need hints
???? Awesome Gift Idea—for Lancaster natives and curious newcomers alike

???? Getting Started Is Easy:
1.Reserve your tickets—just one per player
2.Check your email for download instructions
3.Watch a quick briefing video to get ready
4.Meet your team at the Welcome Center
5.Dive into a one-of-a-kind city experience!
???? Spots are limited—reserve yours today! Whether you’re exploring Lancaster for the first time or rediscovering its charm, this scavenger adventure will change how you see the city!

*** Please note that some days offer multiple start times

title: Fall Fest Days at Refreshing Mountain
description:
Join us for Fall Fest Days at Refreshing Mountain! Celebrate the vibrant autumn season with a variety of exciting activities every weekend.

From zipline cornhole and the Rubber Duckie Drop to high-flying pumpkin smashing, Refreshing Mountain offers families and groups a thrilling outdoor space to gather, adventure, and enjoy fall activities together.

We’ve gamified our ziplines. Not only can you toss fun things from them, you can win a free shirt!

title: Eden Sunday Brunch
description:
Monthly Non-Holiday Sunday Brunch

Hours: 10:30 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.

Please note: our non-holiday Champagne Sunday Brunch is currently held on the 1st and 3rd Sundays of each month.  It will also be held every Sunday between Thanksgiving and Christmas.

title: Lancaster City Fall Art Walk
description:
Explore Lancaster City Art Walk & Hunt for Art! Please Note: A small number of ArtWalk locations are operating on a different schedule.  Businesses that have abbreviated hours or Sunday closure are indicated on the map.

This year’s Lancaster City Fall Art Walk has a new way to explore the city’s galleries, pop-ups, and creative spaces: a self-guided Art Walk Scavenger Hunt!

Pick up your Art Walk map and scavenger hunt sheet at most participating galleries and pop-up locations, then hit the streets and start exploring. Each participating location has a clue tied to artwork on display, with one clue for each numbered location on the map.

How to enter:
• Collect answers to the clues as you make your way around Art Walk
• Get at least 20 answers correct
• Drop your completed sheet in one of the designated drop boxes at the galleries indicated on the map
• One winner will receive a $250 voucher toward a purchase of $250 or more at any LCAC member gallery

Mark your calendars for one of our favorite events of the season!

Take a stroll through the city and explore your favorite galleries, museums, and pop – up artist locations.  Enjoy live demonstrations from talented local and regional artists, along with a variety of fun and festive events for all ages.  It’s the perfect time to start finding that special something for your special someone – just in time as we head into the holiday season!

title: Lancaster Central Market
description:
For almost 300 years people have been coming together to meet at Market to enjoy the freshest local food, ready-made unique dishes and flavors from all over, and special finds you can only get at Lancaster Central Market. Our building is a historic structure with history and beauty around every corner located in the heart of downtown Lancaster.

title: Roots Country Market and Auction
description:
Make Root’s Country Market Your Family’s Destination for Food, Fun, Handcrafted Items, and Much More.

A Variety of Fresh Foods

Fresh-picked, local produce. Farm-raised meats. Mouthwatering, homemade baked goods. Prepared foods for any meal. These are just some of the food choices you’ll enjoy when you visit Root’s Country Market. Stock your pantry for the week or meet friends for a hot lunch. The choice is yours—and the options are virtually endless.

We are open every Tuesday, year-round. Our hours are 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. April through October and 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. November through March.
